# The Name Generators

> Free online name generators for fantasy characters, places, organisations, objects and more: for D&D and other tabletop games, writing, gaming, worldbuilding, music projects and businesses. Each generator page has the generator, example names and an article on the naming conventions behind them.

Names are free to use, no credit needed. If you're naming a business, brand, band or product, check the name isn't already taken or trademarked first.

Made by Rich: https://thenamegenerators.com/about.html

## About the generators

- 236 generators in 25 categories, written in British English.
- Names come from hand-written word lists and naming rules for each setting, not from an AI model. Most options can make hundreds of different names; a few use real historical or canon names and are shorter on purpose.
- Generators avoid copying named characters from games, books and films: they make new names in the same style.
- Where a name uses a real language (Old Norse, Japanese, Chinese, Latin, Old English, Ancient Egyptian), the meaning shown is one we're confident of.
- Names are made in your browser as you click; what you type into a generator is not sent anywhere.

## Blogs & Brands

- [All Blogs & Brands name generators](https://thenamegenerators.com/categories/concepts-names.html): Names for blogs and brands, and how to check they're free to use.
- [Blog Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/blog-name-generator.html): Blog name ideas by topic, from food and travel to books, gardening and money: Crumbs & Butter, Notes from the Potting Shed, One More Chapter.
- [Brand Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/brand-name-generator.html): Brand and product names sorted by industry and feel, from tech and luxury to food, fashion and outdoor, as one word or with a product word (Juniper Botanicals).
- [YouTube Channel Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/youtube-channel-name-generator.html): YouTube channel names by topic (gaming, cooking, tech, travel, music) in the shapes that work on the platform, plus how to check the handle is free.
- [Podcast Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/podcast-name-generator.html): Podcast names that say what the show is like: an adjective and a format (The Curious Hour), or a phrase with personality, plus how to check a name is free.
- [Gamertag Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/gamertag-generator.html): Gamertags and usernames for Xbox, PlayStation, Discord, Steam and social media: cool, funny, fantasy or short, with your own word or name mixed in if you like.

- [Fantasy Town Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/fantasy-town-name-generator.html): Fantasy town and village names built the way real English place names are, for farming villages, fishing ports, mining towns, abbeys, market towns and more.

- [Fantasy City Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/fantasy-city-name-generator.html): Fantasy city names for capitals, fortresses, ports, northern holds, ancient ruins and river towns, with an epithet if you want one: "the City of Bells".
- [Angel Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/angel-name-generator.html): Angel names from scripture and tradition with their Hebrew meanings, or new ones in the same style, with a choir, a domain or an epithet.
- [Alien Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/alien-name-generator.html): Alien names that sound like they come from a real species: clicking insectoids, liquid-voiced aquatics, beings named like Hums-at-Dawn, and galactic nobility.
- [Fairy Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/fairy-name-generator.html): Fairy names from folklore: flower fairies like Thistledown, lords and ladies of the Seelie and Unseelie Courts, and household sprites like Hob o' the Hearth.
- [Fairy Town Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/fairy-town-name-generator.html): Fairy town and village names from folklore: homes under the hill, hollows in the wood, fairy rings and the great courts of the fae.

- [Hobbit Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/hobbit-name-generator.html): Hobbit names in Tolkien's style: plain Shire names ending in -o, grand Took-style names, Buckland names like Meriadoc, and flower names for girls.

- [Spaceship Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/spaceship-name-generator.html): Spaceship names from heroic to strange: classic names (The Distant Horizon), virtues (Fortitude), registry prefixes and Culture-style sentences.
- [Planet Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/planet-name-generator.html): Planet names for sci-fi stories and games: alien-sounding worlds, catalogue numbers like KTS-4417 b, human colonies like New Meridian, and more.
- [Alien Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/alien-name-generator.html): Alien names that sound like they come from a real species: clicking insectoids, liquid-voiced aquatics, beings named like Hums-at-Dawn, and galactic nobility.
- [Robot Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/robot-name-generator.html): Robot and android names: letter-number designations like R2-D2, friendly acronym names, model numbers with a nickname, and human names for androids.
- [AI Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/ai-name-generator.html): Names for artificial intelligences: friendly assistants, ship and station computers, rogue AIs and acronyms with what they stand for.
- [Mecha Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/mecha-name-generator.html): Names for giant robots and mechs: military real-robot frames with model numbers, and super robots with grand prefixes and titles.
- [Cyberpunk Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/cyberpunk-name-generator.html): Cyberpunk names for runners, hackers and fixers: street handles like Glitch and Static, full names with a handle, and megacorporation names.
- [Futuristic Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/futuristic-name-generator.html): Futuristic names for sci-fi characters: sleek first names like Kael and Elara with surnames from around the world, and double-barrelled ones.
- [Steampunk Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/steampunk-name-generator.html): Steampunk names for characters, airships, inventions and companies: Professor Thaddeus Brassworth, the Whistling Albatross and patent inventions.
- [Post-Apocalyptic Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/post-apocalyptic-name-generator.html): Names for the end of the world: survivors with scavenged nicknames, raiders, mutants, settlements and factions of the wasteland.
- [Star Wars Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/star-wars-name-generator.html): Star Wars names for Jedi, Sith Lords, Mandalorians and rebels, following the films and shows: hyphenated Jedi names, Darth titles and clans.

## Witches

- [All Witches name generators](https://thenamegenerators.com/categories/witch-names.html): Witch names for fantasy, games and Halloween: swamp witches, Harry Potter and Hogwarts Legacy witches, Path of Exile witches and more.
- [Coven Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/coven-name-generator.html): Coven names for witches in D&D, stories and games: covens named for a place or the moon, darker covenants and cosy circles, with a motto if you like.
- [Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/witch-name-generator.html): Witch names for stories, games and Halloween: fairy-tale crones, hedge witches, modern witches and funny costume names, with epithets and familiars.
- [Swamp Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/swamp-witch-name-generator.html): Swamp witch and hag names from folklore: Granny Nettle Bogwort, Delphine Murkwater of the bayou, Maud Reedwick of the fens, with an epithet.
- [Harry Potter Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/harry-potter-witch-name-generator.html): Witch names in the style of the Harry Potter books: everyday British or grand pure-blood first names, with a surname to suit each Hogwarts house.
- [Hogwarts Legacy Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/hogwarts-legacy-witch-name-generator.html): Hogwarts Legacy witch names in the game's 1890s style: Victorian first names with surnames to suit Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw or Slytherin.
- [Path of Exile Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/path-of-exile-witch-name-generator.html): Path of Exile Witch names with an epithet to match your Ascendancy: Necromancer, Elementalist, Occultist, or PoE 2's Infernalist and Blood Mage.
- [Wizard Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/wizard-name-generator.html): Wizard names for any school of magic: Aldous the Grey, Hester of Greymere, Archmage Ottilie. Male and female, with epithets for the eight D&D schools.
- [Fairy Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/fairy-name-generator.html): Fairy names from folklore: flower fairies like Thistledown, lords and ladies of the Seelie and Unseelie Courts, and household sprites like Hob o' the Hearth.
- [Spell Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/spell-name-generator.html): Spell names for D&D, stories and games, by school of magic: curses, charms, hexes and wards, with a one-line effect if you want one.

## Historical

- [All Historical name generators](https://thenamegenerators.com/categories/historical-names.html): Real names from history for stories and games: Roman, Ancient Greek, Anglo-Saxon, medieval English, Victorian and Old West.
- [Roman Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/roman-name-generator.html): Real Roman names built the Roman way: praenomen, nomen and cognomen for men (Marcus Tullius Cicero), the family name for women, with meanings.
- [Ancient Greek Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/ancient-greek-name-generator.html): Real Ancient Greek names with their meanings (Nikias, victory; Philippos, lover of horses), as a single name, with a father's name, or with a city.
- [Anglo-Saxon Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/anglo-saxon-name-generator.html): Old English names built the Anglo-Saxon way, from two meaningful parts: Æthelwulf (noble wolf), Eadgifu (prosperity and gift), with the meaning of each part.
- [Medieval Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/medieval-name-generator.html): Real medieval English names with surnames from jobs (Fletcher), places (atte Wode), fathers (FitzWalter) and nicknames, and what each one meant.
- [Victorian Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/victorian-name-generator.html): Real Victorian first names (Ada, Florence, Septimus) with English surnames, plus a title or a real Victorian job like lamplighter or knocker-upper.
- [Old West Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/old-west-name-generator.html): Old West names for cowboys, outlaws and frontier folk: 19th-century American first names with a surname, and a nickname like Two-Gun or Deadeye.
- [Viking Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/viking-name-generator.html): Real Old Norse names with a patronymic (Leifsson, Haraldsdóttir) or a byname like Erik the Red and Harald Fairhair, the way Vikings were actually known.
- [Pirate Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/pirate-name-generator.html): Pirate names in the style of the Golden Age of Piracy, with a nickname like Blackbeard's or Calico Jack's, plus pirate ship names.
- [Knight Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/knight-name-generator.html): Knight names built the medieval way: Sir or Dame, a period first name, and a place, epithet or order, from Sir Ralph of Blackmoor to Dame Isabel.
- [Japanese Sword Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/japanese-sword-name-generator.html): Japanese sword names built from real Japanese words, with meanings: poetic names like Tsuki-kage, "Moon Shadow", and Kumo-giri, "Cloud Cutter".
- [Mummy Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/mummy-name-generator.html): Mummy names from real Ancient Egyptian names, royal and everyday, with what each one means and a title, from Royal Scribe to Keeper of the Western Tombs.

## Pop Culture

- [All Pop Culture name generators](https://thenamegenerators.com/categories/pop_culture-names.html): Names for Hogwarts Legacy, Harry Potter, Skyrim, Warcraft, Warhammer, Lord of the Rings and more.
- [Animatronic Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/animatronic-name-generator.html): Animatronic names for original FNAF-style characters: mascots like Biscuit the Badger, band members, broken-down versions and pizzeria names.
- [Anime Character Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/anime-name-generator.html): Anime names from real Japanese given names and surnames, with meanings: name order, Japanese order, or with honorifics like -kun, -chan and -senpai.
- [Elden Ring Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/elden-ring-name-generator.html): Elden Ring names in FromSoftware's style: a Tarnished name, or a boss-worthy title like Godrick the Grafted or Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.
- [Star Wars Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/star-wars-name-generator.html): Star Wars names for Jedi, Sith Lords, Mandalorians and rebels, following the films and shows: hyphenated Jedi names, Darth titles and clans.
- [Baldur's Gate 3 Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/baldurs-gate-3-name-generator.html): Names for every playable race in Baldur's Gate 3, from tiefling and githyanki to drow and dragonborn, each following that race's D&D naming customs.
- [Harry Potter Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/harry-potter-witch-name-generator.html): Witch names in the style of the Harry Potter books: everyday British or grand pure-blood first names, with a surname to suit each Hogwarts house.
- [Hogwarts Legacy Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/hogwarts-legacy-witch-name-generator.html): Hogwarts Legacy witch names in the game's 1890s style: Victorian first names with surnames to suit Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw or Slytherin.
- [Hogwarts Legacy Wizard Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/hogwarts-legacy-wizard-name-generator.html): Hogwarts Legacy wizard names in the game's 1890s style: Victorian first names with surnames to suit Gryffindor, Hufflepuff, Ravenclaw or Slytherin.
- [Skyrim Orc Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/skyrim-orc-name-generator.html): Generate Skyrim orc names the way the game builds them: a first name plus gro- (son of) or gra- (daughter of) and a parent's name, like Urag gro-Shub.
- [Khajiit Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/khajiit-name-generator.html): Khajiit names for Skyrim, Elder Scrolls Online and your own Tamriel stories, with or without the apostrophe prefixes of names like J'zargo, Ri'saad and M'aiq.
- [Nord Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/nord-name-generator.html): Nord names for Skyrim and ESO: Old Norse first names, family names in the style of Battle-Born and Gray-Mane, or an epithet like the Greater.
- [Argonian Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/argonian-name-generator.html): Argonian names for Skyrim and Elder Scrolls Online: Jel-style names like Jaree-Ra and Keerava, or descriptive names like Scouts-Many-Marshes.
- [Altmer Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/altmer-name-generator.html): Altmer (high elf) names for Skyrim and Elder Scrolls Online, long and elegant like Ancano, Elenwen and Ondolemar, the names of the Summerset Isles.
- [Dunmer Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/dunmer-name-generator.html): Dunmer (dark elf) names for Skyrim, Morrowind and ESO: a first and family name in the style of Revyn Sadri, with an optional Great House.
- [Warhammer 40k Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/warhammer-name-generator.html): Warhammer 40k names for every faction: Space Marine Chapters, Chaos Legions, Guard regiments, Aeldari, Necrons, T'au, Orks, Votann and more.
- [Warhammer Orc Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/warhammer-orc-name-generator.html): Ork and orc names for Warhammer 40,000, the Old World and Age of Sigmar, with titles, clans and nicknames: Big Mek Skabnik 'Eadbanga of da Deathskulls.
- [World of Warcraft Orc Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/wow-orc-name-generator.html): World of Warcraft orc names that fit the game's name rules, plus an earned surname or a Horde clan for your character's story. Male and female.
- [World of Warcraft Troll Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/wow-troll-name-generator.html): Warcraft troll names in the style of Vol'jin, Zul'jin and Talanji, with an optional tribe: Darkspear, Zandalari, Amani, Gurubashi and more.
- [Blood Elf Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/blood-elf-name-generator.html): Blood elf names for World of Warcraft: elegant sin'dorei first names, some with an apostrophe like Kael'thas, and golden, fiery surnames.
- [Night Elf Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/night-elf-name-generator.html): Night elf names for World of Warcraft: a flowing first name and a nature-and-moonlight surname, in the style of Tyrande Whisperwind and Shandris Feathermoon.
- [LOTR Orc Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/lotr-orc-name-generator.html): Orc names in Tolkien's style for Mordor orcs, Uruk-hai of Isengard and goblins of the Misty Mountains, with a rank or the place they serve.
- [LOTR Wizard Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/lotr-wizard-name-generator.html): Wizard names in the style of the Istari of Middle-earth: a colour, an Elvish name built from real Sindarin with its meaning, and a deed.
- [Hobbit Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/hobbit-name-generator.html): Hobbit names in Tolkien's style: plain Shire names ending in -o, grand Took-style names, Buckland names like Meriadoc, and flower names for girls.
- [Ogryn Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/ogryn-name-generator.html): Ogryn names for Warhammer 40,000 and Darktide: short, blunt names with a squad nickname, a deed or a regiment, like Graug 'Doorstop' of the Cadian 88th.
- [Funny Minecraft Sword Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/funny-minecraft-sword-name-generator.html): Funny Minecraft sword names that fit the anvil's rename box, from mob puns like Creeper Sweeper to Bladey McBladeface.
- [Game of Thrones Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/game-of-thrones-name-generator.html): Game of Thrones names by region of Westeros: a noble with a new house, a bastard with the right surname (Snow, Sand, Rivers), or Valyrian and Free Folk.
- [Game of Thrones Sword Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/game-of-thrones-sword-name-generator.html): Game of Thrones style sword names to suit a great house, from northern wolves to Ironborn reavers: Ashsister, a Valyrian steel longsword.
- [Superhero Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/superhero-name-generator.html): Superhero names in the classic comic-book shapes: an adjective and a noun, a something-Man or -Woman, a title like Captain or Doctor, or a single bold word.

## Name tools

Free tools for lists of names; lists stay in the browser and can be shared as a link.

- [Spin the Wheel](https://thenamegenerators.com/spin-the-wheel.html): Spin a wheel of names to pick one at random.
- [Random Name Picker](https://thenamegenerators.com/random-name-picker.html): Draw one name, like a card from a hat.
- [Raffle / Pick a Winner](https://thenamegenerators.com/raffle-picker.html): Numbered tickets, one winner or several.
- [Secret Santa Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/secret-santa-generator.html): Draws pairs so nobody gets themselves.
- [Team Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/team-generator.html): Splits a list into even, random teams.
